name: The Pool of the White Sun
summary: At the pool in Krezk, Ireena saw a young man in the water who knew her by another name.

stages.journal: At the Pool of the White Sun, Ireena saw Sergei von Zarovich in the water beside her reflection, Strahd's brother, dead four hundred years. She remembered being Tatyana: a chapel full of white flowers, a wall, a stair. The water is the only door he has.
stages.hint: At the Pool of the White Sun in Krezk, with Ireena in the party, look at Ireena and help her choose.

stages.journal: Ireena promised Sergei she will come back to the pool when Strahd is dead. Until then she goes where we go.
Ireena chose her own life: Ireena Kolyana, not Tatyana. She said goodbye to the young man in the water.
